propositions: Plan-review gate has no criterion to assess whether a proposed change is actually needed, leaving a gap (over-action) that FixedBench identified at 35-65%.
Bug tickets currently short-circuit plan-review to bare exempt-PASS with no substantive review (verified on bug 5886: REVIEW_RESULT had runner=exempt, verdict=PASS, llm_calls=0).
New advisory criterion 'necessity' should flag plans that add a mechanism without demonstrating the need, accepting justified no-ops and well-motivated outcomes.
Bug tickets should run a lightweight advisory tier (DET floor + necessity probe) instead of skipping review entirely, never blocking bugs.
Both necessity probe and bug-tier pieces must be advisory-only and auto-monitored via standing recorder; promotion to blocking is dogfood-gated on effectiveness metrics.
